digest.component_or_area: completion verifier / budget and banking system
propositions: The verifier step budget exhausts on legitimate validation tasks, causing valid criteria to fail as unmet when they are merely unproven-within-budget, driving operators toward attestation-laundering.

The current budget formula (steps_per_criterion × count, clamped 8/48→480) lacks an evidence-surface term for child ticket traversal and provides no cross-run carryover, forcing re-verification of all criteria on each cycle (~10 min/cycle).

Budget defaults must be raised (8→24 per-criterion, 48→160 floor-min, clamp→960) and the formula extended to include child-traversal scaling (child_traversal × direct_children + fixed_overhead) so legitimate epics with 6+ ACs size to ≥80 requests without exhausting.

Validated PASS verdicts must be cached cross-run with scoped content fingerprints (git blob SHAs of file_impact paths) so re-verifies after exhaustion credit still-valid cached verdicts without re-proving, with invalidation on fingerprint or criterion-text change and fail-open on git errors.

Seeded cached records must bypass finalizer downgrade judgment while same-run finalizer downgrades are preserved, so a cached PASS cannot be contradicted by a later echo within the same run or a subsequent run at the same verified ref.

Runaway guards (tool_calls_limit, loop detection) remain the authoritative containment; the step budget exists only to prevent runaway tool use and must never artificially limit authorized validation.
